Incident cascade (summary):

2) Customer notification (15–60m): For incidents impacting production, Redwood notifies customer primary contact with an acknowledgement template.
3) Escalation to Customer Security/Legal (60–180m): If incident touches regulated data or cross-border concerns, notify our Security & Legal leads; coordinate wording with customer's compliance contact.
4) Regulatory holding (as-needed): For EU data sovereignty incidents, Redwood will coordinate internally with Legal before any data transfer communications.

Jurisdictional notes:
- We can commit to regionally aware acknowledgement times (15m ack for monitored production incidents globally).
- Formal remediation ETA commitments are workload dependent; we provide estimated timelines and regular cadence updates (every 60m) until resolution or handoff.
